name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Summer Internship
org: Art Institute of Chicago with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help with festivals, gallery tours and workshops. They meet museum workers and local artists. They also plan and host creative events for visitors.
who_can_apply: Chicago high school teens who will be at least 16 at the start of the internship.
pay_detail: Paid (the page says all internships are paid). Rate not stated.
deadline_text: Applications open in the spring through After School Matters. Exact 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through After School Matters when the spring window opens.
notes: Run with After School Matters. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
